'''Zenia Farlight''' was corporate security specialist on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] in the wake of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Occupation of Bespin|occupation]] of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. They were investigating the identity of a [[Lobot/Legends|mysterious figure]] operating in the [[City/Legends|city]].<ref name="Game">''[[Gamemaster Toolkit: Live-Action Adventures]]''</ref>
